source.method: Re-traced 2026-11-09 (FOLLOWUPS 58) on the corridor parcel, replacing the trail-distance reach. Taxlots: quadfit s2_lots of quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, every lot with 1% or more of its area in the plan district. Held: a lot that abuts the parcel (5 ft or more of its boundary within 3 ft of it, within 3 ft at any point, or overlapping it), every lot within 25 ft of it (a misdrawn line or a narrow strip between: not shown to be apart), and the corridor's own lots (half or more inside). 365 lots: 294 abutting, 32 within 25 ft, 39 corridor lots. Checks: the Springwater Corridor Trail line (BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers layer 2, fetched 2026-11-01) lies inside the parcel buffered 5 ft along all 31,337 ft of it in the plan district; abutting lot lines sit 0 to 1 ft off the parcel. Against the 2026-11-08 split tracing: 49 lots newly held (none GREEN in rel4), 400 released (none held by it alone in rel4); the South and Flood Risk Area lots among the released stay in johnson-creek-land-division-lots, which is unchanged.
